research_question: Can a high-precision normalized metric-to-row linker convert safe automatic-variable abstentions into exact gold-row selections without increasing false confidence?

observation.production_baseline_behavior: Without an independent semantic approval, automatic variable_binding is UNRESOLVED with V2_ROUTE_CONCEPT_IS_NOT_SOURCE_VARIABLE_EVIDENCE.

hypothesis.observed_phenomenon: The current automatic path always abstains on source-variable identity even when a question and one source row share a distinctive financial metric phrase.
hypothesis.possible_cause: The fail-closed production baseline lacks a machine-calibrated exact-row semantic linker.
hypothesis.expected_improvement: A normalized token-F1 linker with a strict unique-best margin should safely bind a subset of exact gold rows and leave ambiguous rows abstained.
hypothesis.possible_side_effect: Generic financial words or near-duplicate rows could make an incorrect row appear uniquely best.
hypothesis.questions_that_should_improve: Questions with exactly one gold table row and a distinctive row-label phrase after financial stopword and light morphology normalization.
hypothesis.questions_that_should_remain_unchanged: Questions requiring text evidence, multiple table rows, rows below the score threshold, ties/near-ties, and ambiguous generic labels.

split_design.selection_key: sha256(seed + canonical question text + canonical table content); source record ID excluded
split_design.company_holdout: FinQA issuer IDs are pairwise disjoint across stages.
split_design.wording_holdout: Development and untouched normalized wording templates are disjoint.
split_design.metric_holdout: At least one intrinsic metric family has six or more untouched records and zero development records.
split_design.composition_holdout: At least one program-operation signature has six or more untouched records and zero development records.

evaluator.kind: FinQA official gold_inds with exactly one table_N key and no text_N key
